info.name: Crafting Service
info.description:
Test collection for the Crafting Service (`services/crafting-service`).

Run the folders top to bottom (or use the Collection Runner). **Recipes > Create Recipe** and **Create Second Recipe** create two fresh recipes and store their ids/names as collection variables that the later requests use; **Cleanup** deletes them.

Variable `baseUrl` defaults to `http://localhost:5198` (the `dotnet run` / Docker port).

Only implemented endpoints are covered (`/api/status` and `/api/recipes` CRUD). `POST /api/crafting/craft` and `GET /api/players/{player_id}/recipes/available` are documented in the service README as planned but not yet implemented.
